installCommand: R="$PWD"; while [ ! -d "$R/apps/landing" ] && [ "$R" != / ]; do R="$(dirname "$R")"; done; cd "$R" && npm ci
buildCommand: R="$PWD"; while [ ! -d "$R/apps/landing" ] && [ "$R" != / ]; do R="$(dirname "$R")"; done; (cd "$R" && npx tsx apps/landing/build.ts --live) && mkdir -p vercel-out && cp -R "$R/apps/landing/dist/." vercel-out/

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'
